questions.question_text: Which shortcut key combination is used to open the 'Find and Replace' dialog box in MS Word?
questions.explanation: Ctrl + H opens the 'Replace' tab of the Find and Replace dialog box, whereas Ctrl + F directly opens the Navigation pane for searching.

questions.question_text: In Microsoft Excel, which formula correctly calculates the average of cells A1 through A10?
questions.explanation: The built-in function in MS Excel to calculate the arithmetic mean is =AVERAGE(range).

questions.question_text: What is the file extension of a macro-enabled presentation file in Microsoft PowerPoint?
questions.explanation: .pptm is the standard file extension for PowerPoint presentations that contain macros or VBA code.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is considered volatile memory in a computer system?
questions.explanation: RAM is volatile memory, meaning it loses all its stored data when the power supply to the computer is turned off.

questions.question_text: In MS Excel, what symbol must precede every formula or function?
questions.explanation: All formulas and functions in Excel must start with an equals sign (=) so Excel knows to calculate a value rather than treat it as plain text.

questions.question_text: Which shortcut key combination is used to paste copied content in MS Windows?
questions.explanation: Ctrl + V is the standard keyboard shortcut for pasting clipboard items.

questions.question_text: In MS Excel, what type of chart is best suited for showing trends over a period of time?
questions.explanation: Line charts are ideal for displaying data trends across continuous intervals like time.

questions.question_text: What is the maximum number of worksheets that can be created by default in a new MS Excel workbook (in recent versions)?
questions.explanation: While older versions defaulted to 3 sheets, modern Excel allows as many sheets as system memory permits, defaulting to 1 initially.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an example of an operating system?
questions.explanation: Ubuntu is a popular Linux-based operating system, whereas the others are application software.

questions.question_text: What does LAN stand for in computer networking?
questions.explanation: LAN connects computers within a limited geographical area such as a school, office, or building.

questions.question_text: Which feature in MS Word allows you to send personalized letters or emails to a list of multiple recipients?
questions.explanation: Mail Merge combines a main document with a data source to generate multiple customized documents efficiently.

questions.question_text: In computer terminology, what does 'HTTP' stand for?
questions.explanation: HTTP is the foundational protocol used for transmitting hypermedia documents on the World Wide Web.

questions.question_text: Which function in MS Excel is used to find the largest value in a range of cells?
questions.explanation: The MAX function returns the highest numerical value in a given set of arguments or cell range.

questions.question_text: What is the extension of a template file created in Microsoft Word?
questions.explanation: .dotx is the standard file format extension for Word templates in modern Office versions.

questions.question_text: Which hardware device is considered the 'brain' of the computer?
questions.explanation: The Central Processing Unit (CPU) executes instructions and performs core computational tasks.
